item.title: Advent of Compiler Optimisations 2025
item.description:
📝 Introducing the Advent of Compiler Optimisations 2025 Today I’m announcing a project that’s been in the making for around a year. This December will be the Advent of Compiler Optimisations: I’ll release one blog post and video each day, each detailing a fun and interesting C or C++ optimisation that your compiler can do. I’ll be covering some very low-level, architecture-specific tricks as well as larger, more high-level optimisations.
🔗 Read more: https://xania.org/202511/advent-of-compiler-optimisation

item.title: Man unexpectedly cured of HIV after stem cell transplant
item.description:
📝 “The belief was that using these HIV-resistant stem cells was essential,” says Gaebler. “Essentially, the pool of host cells to infect runs dry,” says Gaebler. These make the donor cells recognise residual recipient cells as a threat to eliminate, says Gaebler.
